rows.translation_en:
Youth lasts roughly six months after
joining the fighting force. This is when Body grows
fastest and Health recovers most impressively!!
They grow so much it's almost funny,
and seem to know nothing of fatigue,
so it's tempting to push them too hard.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
But their HP is still only half-grown,
while their confidence is full-sized. Accidents
can happen before you can even gasp...
It's an important time!!
Please keep that firmly in mind.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
From about eight months to a year and two months,
growth in Spirit, Skill, and Body, Health recovery,
and everything else are at their most balanced.
Those with potential in Skill will learn
all sorts of spells at once
and let their talents blossom with a bang!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Health lost during a sortie
recovers to some extent naturally
when the month changes.
When you're young,
even if you're tired enough to drop,
a night's sleep leaves you fresh tomorrow!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
But as you get older,
fatigue becomes harder to shake off...
The old man across the street said,
"I really tried racing my grandchild,
and I was laid up for a week."
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
Male pronoun is warranted by the explicit old man across the street.

rows.translation_en:
If someone returns wounded from battle
with only a little Health
remaining...
In the worst case,
they may simply run out of strength
and die before their natural time.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
To keep that from happening,
always fight to survive
and see another tomorrow.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
If someone's Loyalty to the %@ clan
falls far enough, they may be driven
to run away from home.
Anyone who runs away will never return.
Apparently, they may also take
money or items without permission.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
People with strong Earth or Water Spirit
are fairly patient and won't usually run away
unless something very serious happens.
But people with high Fire Spirit
are quick to lose their temper...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
As for people with high Wind Spirit,
it can be hard to tell
what they're thinking in the first place...
In any case, please always
watch your family's Loyalty.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
"I'm in perfect health, but they never
let me join the party..."
"I put all that thought into my proposals,
but not one gets accepted..."
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
When grievances like those pile up,
people tend to lose their motivation.
Their Loyalty to the %@ clan
will gradually fade too...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
To keep that from happening,
respect their initiative whenever you can.
And now and then, give them a great big compliment!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
If HP stays low during battle or travel,
Health keeps dropping
without you even noticing.
When the month changes, that fatigue hits all at once,
weakening HP, Attack, Defense, Agility,
and every other physical ability.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
On long expeditions that cross into another month,
you must take special care.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Pushing deep into an oni nest
before you're strong enough
is like going there to be killed.
Please, absolutely do not do it!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
When you can knock over the local oni commander
with a flick of your little finger,
that's about the right time to press on.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Whatever happens during battle,
while traveling, keep everyone's HP
as close to maximum as possible.
If you save your healing items and spells,
force a march, and end up losing a life,
you've defeated the whole purpose.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Forty percent of defeats come from being too weak.
The other sixty percent come from the baseless belief,
"We'll still be all right."
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
The 40/60 split is Itsuka's assertion, retained without presenting it as a verified game statistic.

rows.translation_en:
If you seize an opening while moving
and charge an enemy from behind,
you can strike first in battle.
But running round and round
trying to get behind them is, frankly,
undignified and a waste of time!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Professor Itsuka will give you
a special lesson in how it's done!!
Ahem...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Face the enemy and feint one step to the right.
The instant they turn right, hold X
and slip to their left!!
Of course, you can reverse left and right.
Try it on your next hunt.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
No matter how deep you are
in a cave or dungeon, choosing Return
will bring you back to Kyoto at any time.
So there's absolutely no need
to worry about the journey home!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Go as far as you can
and fight with all your strength!! Then, if things
look even slightly bad, choose Return at once.
Pushing your luck pays off
at most one time in ten.
And even that one time is just a fluke.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Hold X while moving
to run at twice
your normal speed.
But be careful!!
Running also makes you tire
at twice the usual rate.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
If the Health warning appears,
drop everything and restore HP immediately.
If everyone looks all right, hold X again!!
That's the secret to long expeditions.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
The pack is the bag of items
your party takes on a hunt.
It holds only thirty items.
Unnecessary things just get in the way.
And if an enemy steals them, it's a total loss...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Take only the bare minimum of consumables.
Leave with space to spare and return full of treasure!!
That's the ideal way to use your pack.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
The storehouse is where you keep items
you don't plan to use right away.
Either when you return from a hunt
or before setting out, always make sure
to sort your spoils.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
You can decide what to sell or keep later.
For now, anything you don't need next time
goes straight from the pack into the storehouse!!
I'll carry it all over,
so please don't put it off, %$.
Let's get it tidied away.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
If two or more party members
can use the same attack spell,
please try combining it.
The spell takes a little longer to go off,
but the effect more than makes up for that delay
with a tremendous bang!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
The more people join in,
the bigger and bigger the effect!!
...It's truly amazing!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Most spells are named
after the deity
who created them.
So when you obtain
a new scroll, open Divine Union,
then Deities, and take a look.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
You might enjoy imagining things like,
"Oh my! Such a gentle face,
and such a vicious spell..."
Some weapons and armor are named
after deities too, but those names
were simply chosen by humans.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
The hypothetical remark about a deity uses no inferred gender.

rows.translation_en:
There are two conditions
for learning to use a spell.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
First, the %@ clan
must own that spell's scroll.
If you find an oni with a scroll,
chase it down and take it!!
You need only one scroll of each kind.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
The other condition
is that your Spirit and Skill
have grown enough to meet its requirements.
Open Clan, then Details, then Spells:
the learning requirements appear at the lower left.
Check them now and then!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
This important ceremony unites you
with a deity to receive a child.
You can perform it only once a month,
but you can choose whatever month
suits you throughout the year.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
For Divine Union, men choose a goddess,
and women choose a god.
The child will inherit
both parents' good points and bad points
without the slightest mercy.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
They're gods, so naturally
they're terribly important,
but they're far from all-powerful and all-knowing.
Some have amazing HP but are hopeless with spells.
Some act quickly but have no strength at all.
Everyone has strengths and weaknesses.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
It's especially tricky when the maternal genes
are perfect but the paternal genes aren't so good...
Which way will the child turn out?
So think about what sort of successor you want,
study the deity's genetic information carefully,
and take your time choosing.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
Odd/even gambling metaphor adapted as which way the child will turn out.

rows.translation_en:
Though you probably won't suffer divine punishment
for choosing by looks alone!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
These are the clan's merit points, offered
to the deity you choose for Divine Union.
Defeating oni and monsters earns Offering Points
in the same amount as Victory Points.
To the gods, no gift could be finer!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
There are a few exceptions,
but generally, the more points a deity requires,
the more powerful they are.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Divine Union doesn't just
make your clan stronger.
The deities grow too.
Each union improves the chosen deity's
genetic information, sometimes a lot,
but usually just a little.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
So if you keep choosing
your favorite deity for Divine Union,
their ranking in heaven might eventually change???
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
The symbol of the %@ clan head.
This important accessory passes
to each new clan head.
I've heard it houses the soul
of your father, %$, who was famed
as the greatest swordsman of his age.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
The clan head's father is explicit in source; no gender is inferred for the player.

rows.translation_en:
In battle, choose Skills, then Clan Head's Ring.
You can use it only once
per hunt.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

You can use it only once
per hunt.

rows.translation_en:
When a child leaves their divine parent's side
and comes to the %@ house, they receive
an Div. Favor Orb.
Hold it up to the heavens in battle, and once only,
the user's divine parent
will display their power.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

and comes to the %@ house, they receive
an Orb of Divine Favor.
Hold it up to the heavens in battle, and once only,
the user's divine parent

rows.translation_en:
Even a deity who became a parent
half by chance can't help
butting in when their child is involved...
Well, think of it as being a good child.
Call them with an Div. Favor Orb now and then
and let them see you're doing well.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.

The deity's gender remains unspecified.

Call them with an Orb of Divine Favor now and then

rows.translation_en:
Incidentally, for certain reasons,
adoptees and children of clan deities
cannot use these. Please understand.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
If hitting them doesn't work, try fire magic!!
If fire magic doesn't work, try wind magic!!
However strong an enemy is,
there must be a weakness somewhere.
Find it and overwhelm them
with everything you've got!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Oh... But what if the enemy
uses that strategy on us?
...Please think about that too!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
When a deity sends word
that the clan head's time is near,
I'll quietly let you know.
I don't really like
having this job,
but someone has to tell you...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Um... Well... What I mean is...
If you could prepare yourself and think,
"Perhaps it's almost time. I'll make ○○ the next head,"
it would make things
a little easier for me too...
I'm sorry for being so selfish.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
Hypothetical successor remains the original ○○; self-conscious apologies are spoken character text.

rows.translation_en:
I hardly need to say it now,
but anyone born to the %@ clan
has a life too short even to grieve over.
It varies from person to person,
but a year and a half on average,
two years at most. That's the reality.

rows.translation_en:
Please give every single day meaning,
and always take care
never to waste one.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
After about a year and two months,
fatigue starts lingering a little...
Body growth slows to a trickle...
But the strength you've already gained
is worlds apart from that of the young,
and Spirit and Skill can still grow!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
It's too soon to act old!!
Stand firm on the front line
and show everyone how it's done.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
You suddenly notice your Health slipping...
You're only half as spry as you once were...
That's aging.
But nothing can replace your experience!!
Train the younger generation
and put that experience to work.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
And your spells are still as powerful as ever!!
When it counts, bring out your best move
and show the enemy what you're made of.
Children grow by watching their parents.
Leave no regrets behind. Let yourself blossom
one last time with a bang!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
These are your four physical abilities:
HP, Attack, Defense, and Agility.
Their growth differs slightly
between men and women.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Physical abilities also become
gradually harder to maintain as you age.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
How quickly and how often you act in battle,
and how well you avoid
enemy attacks,
are determined by Agility.
Wind Body governs that Agility.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
When an enemy hits you with a nonmagical attack,
the higher your Defense,
the less damage you take.
Earth Body is the foundation of that Defense.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
When you attack with a weapon,
higher Attack means more damage
to the enemy.
Fire Body is the source of that Attack.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
In the end, how much damage
you can withstand from enemy attacks
comes down to HP.
Water Body is the source of that HP.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
People with high Wind Spirit
think freely and fearlessly!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
The short positive claim continues into the examples in 1:228.

rows.translation_en:
Many are natural geniuses who propose
battle-turning tactics that brilliantly
exploit an enemy's weakness.
I'm sure those who devise new secret arts
must have high Wind Spirit too.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
But they can get too clever for their own good,
and they're a little... quite a bit... perhaps?
Selfish and fickle, you might say.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
If I had to sum up someone with high Earth Spirit,
I'd say they're the unsung backbone of the group!!
They look before they leap.
Their preferred tactics are cautious and unshowy,
and can seem a little roundabout
or indecisive.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
But when it comes down to the very end,
these are the people you can rely on!!
That's what I think.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.
Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
People with strong Fire Spirit
are proactive, aggressive, and a bit short-tempered!!
They tend to act before thinking.
Brave and bold, or reckless, depending on your view.
Quick to flare up and cool down,
their emotions can be quite uneven.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
But they're simple at heart... or rather, straightforward.
If you manage their moods well,
I'm sure they'll do great things.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
In short, this is a person's personality.
It greatly affects their proposed tactics
and how sharply their Loyalty rises and falls.
One other important thing:
Spirit growth is essential for learning spells and secret arts!!
...Please don't forget that.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.
Spirit affects suggested tactics and Loyalty changes; it is not MP.

rows.translation_en:
People with high Water Spirit
are very kind, always putting
their allies' lives first.
But that kindness can work against them,
leaving them without the forcefulness a crucial moment needs...
They're not entirely free of that weakness.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Someone without flaws would be boring.
Making up for each other's faults and forgiving them...
That's what being a family means.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Wind Skill is involved in many spells.
One of its most important roles
is maximizing the effect of an attack.
When an ally's attack and the power of Wind Skill
work together perfectly, there will scarcely
be anyone left standing in the enemy ranks!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Spells cast by those with excellent Wind Skill
are also more likely to affect enemies.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
review_notes: Source trailing thoughts and conditional examples are retained; original rows and line-break counts are unchanged.

rows.translation_en:
Earth Skill's main role is to reduce
the damage allies take from spells.
In other words, it's defense against magic.
People with high Earth Skill
are also harder for enemy spells to affect.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 160-239. Entries 158-159 before and 240-243 after examined. Aging, health, loyalty, spell learning, Divine Union, and stat attributes. Personal pronouns refer to the speaker or an explicitly identified person.
